title: ios-service-observers
responsibility: Owns the ios-service-observers build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: observeIosServices.rows
inputs.description: A map keyed by process ID whose values record each service's start time and executable path before the build. A null baseline is rejected, and only rows whose executable matches a discovered platform service are watched.

inputs.name: observeIosServices.group
inputs.description: The process group supplied when classifying matching existing services; it matters when a discovered service path is present in the baseline and must be attested. The declared type accepts any JavaScript number.

outputs.name: observeIosServices
outputs.description: Resolves to the BuildObservation produced for this baseline. Its check reports clear only while watched services retain their live process identity, remain delegated, and the observation signal is not aborted; existing services are never owned or signalled by this script.

errors.name: Existing iOS service observation or identity failure
errors.description: The function throws Error if rows is null, a matching existing service is not classified as delegated, or its process identity cannot be anchored as alive. Rejections from awaited service discovery or process checks also reject this async call.
